/* 01 — about */

The mind
behind the code

I'm Sanchari Karmakar Shakti — a recently graduated BSc. CSE from City University, Bangladesh. I'm a Software Developer first: I build and ship real products, from full-stack web apps to cross-platform mobile apps.

My stack is the MERN stack with React + Vite, Firebase, and Cloudinary on the web, and React Native (Expo) on mobile — including ColdChain-Rx, a healthcare logistics app built on HL7 FHIR standards. I take projects from concept to deployed.

Alongside development I work as an IT Project Manager, applying Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall to lead workflows and coordinate teams, and I build AI automation pipelines with Claude and Gemini. Across four certified internships — including Excelerate and the Aspire Program (The Nexgenix LTD., CUET IT Incubator) — I also handled recruitment, HR and admin operations, which is where my leadership and team handling skills come from.

// 01 — mobile + web
AndroidiOSWeb
ColdChain-Rx
Healthcare Logistics · Cold-Chain Medication Tracking

A secure healthcare logistics system for hospital inpatient cold-chain medication tracking — keeping temperature-sensitive drugs like insulin and vaccines inside their safe range from pharmacy to bedside. Built with React Native (Expo) and Node.js, it speaks real hospital interoperability standards instead of a mock API: live EHR queries, drug-safety validation, and a tamper-evident audit trail.

▸
EHR Querying via HL7 FHIR MedicationRequest resources
▸
Drug Dosage Validation against the NIH RxNorm API
▸
Legacy HL7 v2 Parsing — OMP^O09 pharmacy order messages
▸
HIPAA-compliant Push Notifications with PHI stripped before dispatch
▸
SHA-256 Audit Trail written as FHIR AuditEvent records
React NativeExpo Node.jsHL7 FHIR HL7 v2RxNorm API HIPAASHA-256
